title: Dos and Don’ts / flat color
slide_intent: Keep color treatment consistent so effects do not change the visual language unpredictably.
strategic_value: Flat color can preserve DB’s clear graphic contrast across layouts.
demonstration: A flat-color composition sits beside a crossed-out gradient treatment.
practical_value: Use uniform color fills rather than a gradient in the shown design system.
